name: Function generator
summary: Sine, square, triangle, pulse, noise and arbitrary waveforms into 50 Ω.
description: A bench function generator up to 10 MHz: sine, square, triangle, pulse with adjustable duty, band-limited noise and a 16-point arbitrary waveform, behind a 50 Ω output. The waveform is played by the analog solver itself, so filters and amplifiers respond exactly as they would in SPICE.
author: Breadbox

highlights.label: Waveforms
